Status.note: The EIA-860M table for August 2026 lists Cimarron River generator 1 as operating, 50.0 MW, natural gas steam turbine, in service since October 1963. It shows no planned retirement date.

units.notes: The unit is still operating. I found no retirement, mothballing or sale. A web search found no announcement, and the Kansas Corporation Commission 2025 retirement report says no retirement requests were made in 2024, though that report covers coal and nuclear units.

source_log.note: The file loads. Plant 1230 generator 1 is operating with no planned retirement.
Seen only in search results. I did not open it, and it covers coal and nuclear units.

No public notice matched this plant. KEIMS permit search needs a login for non-notice permits. A KDHE draft permit for Cimarron Generation (CSP03270) was seen in the notice list but its documents returned 404 on KDHE and I did not find an archived copy.
